scope: Chapter 6 of the Moin scene prototype (src/story/scenes/06.ts): character lines, Jensen's voice message, the gull interlude, replays, lock, oral practice and new story phrases with plurals
notes: Whisper writes the lone word Tee as "T." and numbers as digits; those takes were compared by hand and say the text as written.
Mateo's line "Ich backe … Brot. Nur Brot. Bis in die Nacht!" lost a word in all three takes; it was rewritten as "Ich backe nur Brot. Bis in die Nacht!" and voiced again with four takes.
The chosen take has the closest transcript, an end level below -32 dB and no fragment flagged by tails.py; tails.py also passes on all 52 imported files.

On 9 November 2026 the recurring key words became story phrases so that narration needs no untranslated German: das Wort, wie immer, hinten, niemand, der ganze Club, flach and weg. Three takes each, all transcribed correctly except one take of weg; the chosen takes end below -32 dB.

files.text: Hier, mein Kassenbuch. Jeden Tag, jede Stunde!

files.text: Am Sonntag um halb sechs ist der Club leer. Alle trinken Tee – hinten, auf der Terrasse.

files.text: Und ich passe auf den Club auf! Am Vormittag, jeden Tag!

files.text: Der ganze Club ist hinten. Vorne ist niemand!
